stamp.threshold_policy: CORRECTED SCHEME FOR EVERY HEAD (tcga_full variant) - knn: k=35 scores, tau refit on TCGA out-of-fold at that k (knn_k35_thresholds.json); lin/ann/proto/rf: rate-matched (quantile) threshold on the mean probability of the seed models, r from tau_TCGA on TCGA out-of-fold. AUROC of a corrected row is that of the score its cut point uses.
